That shared defect has now been repaired upstream at ggen-marketplace PR #321 exact head 2b3d6a9cc86ee6fe7b4ce267fb01433ce9201253. The three affected consumers remain REPAIR_REQUIRED until the repaired producer is admitted to the canonical lineage and each consumer is regenerated/re-executed. XaaS additionally retains independent local native-CI debt: ExUnit rejects a setup {:skip, reason} return when cnv-deploy is absent.
